Nested runtime examples explicitly have no prescribed encapsulation rules
Config file minimum field content mandatory while serialization format unspecified
Resources are required described needs, not measured utilization telemetry
Internal software ImageLoad/StartOrder not CSAPI remote Commands
Container and VM network access required but no public CSAPI endpoint proven
OCI runtime bundle version v1.0.2 distinct from buildable OCI image spec
VM appliance distribution DMTF OVF2.1.1 separate from live hypervisor version
Container orchestration and host security permissions deliberately unspecified
Intermodule communication network mandatory but intra-module containers/VM communication undefined
ARINC653 partition time windows only observational intended source behavior
FACE OSS Edition3.1 source companion not audited; Safety/Security/General Purpose variants
RTE profile config sections point to §14.3.1 as common requirements but common fields appear in §14.2

exact_holds.description: RTE alternatives are software execution profiles, not mandatory installed sensor chassis
Procurable Unit with RTE differs from SOSA module with many software artifacts
Nested runtime profile examples do not create encapsulation Rules
Shared minimum RTE configuration fields do not prescribe file serialization format
XML/JSON/YAML is only a recommended format, not SOSA JSON schema
Custom config attributes and nested config references are Permissions, not SHALLs
ProfileType/ImageLoad/Resources/FileSystem/StartOrder are source-specific conditional fields, not adopted DIM fields
FACE OSS Edition3.1 POSIX and ARINC653 originals not inspected
FACE Rule14.3.1-1 has no printed Conformance Method; no FACE certification claimed
Profile config paragraphs §14.3.3,14.4.3,14.5.3 reference §14.3.1 although shared fields appear §14.2
OCI Runtime1.0.2 original normative specification not independently read
OCI Image spec described but source only mandates run-time bundles; do not invent image build
DMTF OVF2.1.1 original spec unread and no installed virtual appliances witnessed
Container and VM network access not real CSAPI System discovery or published services
Intra-module multiple container/VM communication not specified
Container orchestrator and multi-container lifecycle management unspecified
Container host-resource security/permissions expressly not specified
NIST SP800-190, NIST SP800-125 and SRG/STIG pointers do not prove full original source coverage
ARINC653 partition scheduling time-window sharing unspecified and Observational
Future filesystem/blockIO/RDMA access not present mandatory runtime guarantee
Three runtime-specific six Demonstration(D) steps are internal operations not client Command semantics
No actual CPU/memory/network port counts, utilization or software image/version from four source cases
Six original RTE figures' pixel geometry not independently examined
Eight original C239 DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI companions, later S251, restricted AppendixC remain held
Chapter15 intermodule interaction definitions remain unread in this packet
No adopted DIM/Profile class, field, cardinality, SHALL or independent runtime conformance
